author: fable-cursor
criterion: Grass ripples independently of the canopy sway; no lock-step motion.
note: Own motion pair rendered from 973a21e in a detached worktree (settle 12, SwiftShader, t = 12.5 and 13.0 s), since the take's motion frame is not published to the monitor. Mean absolute difference per region out of 255: grass verges 7.4 and 7.9 (25-29 % of pixels moving), branch leaves 9.1 (25 %), hedge above the stair 4.4, house moss roof 3.2, near canopy 1.3 (3.5 %), far trunks 2.0. Four clearly separated amplitudes and the amplified difference image shows the grass moving tuft by tuft while the canopy above it is almost still, so there is no lock-step. Nit: the near canopy and the far crowns are close to static, so the slow branch layer barely reads. Auto: vegetation.windLayers 3, trees.windLayers 3, motionRegionsMoving 11.
